verdict.rationale: Filing or application status lookup is a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only robots.txt 403 probes for mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing beyond those was fetched, so there is no evidence about a public status-tracking page.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
